name: Firebomb
primary:
An exploding fire projectile. On yourself, an explosive dash.
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 2.5-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 1.75 ❤ fire + 1 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.95 s
self_description:

• Damage 1.75 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)

For half a second you leave a trail of 1-block zones lasting 2 s; every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 1.75 ❤ fire + 1 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
